query: Big Tech M&A activity 2026 pace, record $10B+ deals, and antitrust environment for large tech acquisitions in 2026
answer:
I've completed the research on Big Tech M&A activity in 2026. Here's a summary of the key findings:

## Summary

**M&A Pace — Record-Breaking:**
- H1 2026 hit **$2.8 trillion** in global announced deals (up 48% YoY), the strongest first half since LSEG records began in 1980
- Full-year pace projected at **$4–5.3 trillion** (Bain, PwC), with 2025 having set a $4.9T record
- A "supersizing" dynamic: deal **count is down ~9%** to a six-year low even as values soar — fewer but far larger deals

**$10B+ Mega-Deals — Record Concentration:**
- **47 mega-deals totaling >$1.3 trillion** in H1 2026 = nearly 50% of all M&A volume (all-time record share)
- Bain: megadeals up 52% in number, 53% in value YoY
- Top 2026 deals are heavily tech/AI-linked: SpaceX–xAI (~$250B), Paramount–WBD (~$111B), NextEra–Dominion, BlackRock/EQT–AES ($33.4B for AI data-center power)

**Antitrust Environment — More Permissive but Selective:**
- Trump 2.0's FTC (Ferguson) and DOJ (Slater) revived merger remedies/divestitures; 381 early terminations granted in 2025 vs. ~0 under Biden
- Enforcement is selective, not absent (FTC challenged 9 deals in 2025 vs. 5 prior)
- Key Big Tech watchpoints: Senate calls to probe Meta/Google/Nvidia "reverse acqui-hire" structures; EU tightening digital enforcement even as the US eases; a federal court vacated the FTC's expanded HSR form in H1 2026

The favorable US regulatory backdrop is a primary enabler of the mega-deal surge. Full prose report, structured data points, and all sources have been recorded via the StructuredOutput tool. Note that some headline deal values vary across sources and a few may be proposed/pending rather than closed.
